name: NectarViper V3
drivetrain: Mecanum with Dual Dead-Wheel Odometry + Pinpoint IMU
description: NectarViper V3 is a high-speed, lightweight cycler optimized for the 2025-2026 BIOBUZZ game. Designed with a custom carbon-fiber chassis, high-intake compliant rollers, an active indexer, and an ultra-rigid 3-stage continuous rigging linear slide system.

subsystems.name: Chassis & Drivetrain
specs: Carbon fiber bellypan & CNC milled 6061-T6 aluminum side plates
GOBILDA Pinpoint Odometry Computer + 2x Optical Encoders
subsystems.highlights: Achieves 1.85 m/s top speed with under 0.5° heading drift across 30 seconds of autonomous movement.
subsystems.iterationNotes: V1 used standard channel plates; V2 reduced weight by 3.2 lbs with pocketed plates; V3 added enclosed wire channels.

subsystems.name: Bio-Roller Compliant Intake
specs: 1x goBILDA 5203 (1170 RPM) + 1x Axon Mini Servo for wrist articulation
Dual-durometer 35A/50A custom 3D printed silicone compliant flaps
Color-sensor thresholding for instant pollen element sorting
subsystems.highlights: Ingests elements at any orientation within a 120° front capture funnel in under 0.4 seconds.
subsystems.iterationNotes: V1 suffered from element jamming; V2 introduced a floating passive ramp; V3 added high-speed reverse purge.

subsystems.name: Continuous Rigging High-Speed Lift
specs: 3-Stage custom Misumi SAR220 linear rail assembly with Kevlar cord
Custom magnetic limit switch for zero-backlash home calibration
subsystems.highlights: Reaches full extension (38 inches) in 0.65 seconds with closed-loop PIDF velocity profiling.
subsystems.iterationNotes: V1 had string fraying issues; V2 switched to 150lb braided Kevlar line with dynamic tensioning spring.

subsystems.name: Dual-Axis Virtual 4-Bar Claw
specs: 2x Gobilda Torque Servos with 270° active positioning
Custom TPU compliant gripper pads for multi-angle deposit
Fast-release quick dump toggle for basket scoring
subsystems.highlights: Allows 180° wrist flip for both high basket scoring and low chamber specimen clip scoring.
subsystems.iterationNotes: V1 was rigid; V2 added compliant TPU pads to absorb driver alignment error.

subsystems.name: Autonomous Vision & Pedro Pathing
specs: Pedro Pathing Bezier trajectory generation with live curvature-limiting
Limelight 3A / OpenCV color segmentation for sample detection
State machine architecture with asynchronous non-blocking actions
subsystems.highlights: Consistent 5-element autonomous routine with sub-inch positional repeatability.
subsystems.iterationNotes: Migrated from standard Road Runner to Pedro Pathing for tighter curve following and 15% faster auto times.
